purpose: Bounded capture of official ANA, INDECI/COEN and related public sources that may name La Capitana, Hualaca or Higuerón in Tumbes. Captured bytes are archived with their real SHA-256; identity decisions are recorded separately and only from archived text.

search_terms.note: Recorded only to keep a similar-looking official name apart from Hualaca; it is not a search for an alias.

limits.retain_rule_note: Explicit seeds, and the PDF attachments linked as 'DESCARGAR' from a seed INDECI report page, are always archived. Probes, sweep ids and documents reached through search are archived only if their text names a search term and also contains 'Tumbes'; same-name places elsewhere (e.g. El Higuerón, Paimas, Piura) are logged as not retained, never merged.

sigrid_id_sweep.why: ANA 2015-2016 SIGRID series of quebrada maps; ids 3750 (La Tucilla) and 3753 (Los Pozos) are Tumbes maps already cited on main. Each id is downloaded and kept only if it names a search term and Tumbes.

supplement_documents.why: Independent scientific review on PR #364 (2026-10-08) reports that ANA names 'Qda. Hualaca' in Anexo II of Decreto de Urgencia 015-2023, row 17, distrito San Jacinto, sector Higuerón. Archived to read that row from the bytes.
supplement_documents.route_rule: Routes are tried in order. The exact official URL (direct, then any Wayback 'id_' replay of it) is accepted as served. Files reached through an official landing page (ANA repository item for DU 015-2023, MEF norm page) are accepted only if their text names Hualaca, and are recorded as a different publication of the annex, never as the ANA file itself.
